description: Pressure and flow measurements come from a 65-metre, 25-millimetre pipe supplied by a 1.5-kilowatt pump. Three leak sizes were tested at positions 15, 30 and 50 metres along the pipe. This resource is provided by Joseph van der Walt; PS Heyns; DN Wilke. Coverage is site as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. The provider lists RAR formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: CC BY 4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The rig is intended to assess noise and model error. Its scale limits direct transfer to utility networks. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-epanet. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
